caption:
Check your UAE residence visa expiry before you check anything else.

There is a refusal reason that has nothing to do with your money, your job or your itinerary: your residence visa expires too soon after your trip.

Consulates want to see that your right to live here extends well past your return date. If it does not, the whole return-to-UAE logic collapses. Renew first, apply second.
